name: gomlx-batch-provenance-across-dataset-pipelines
instr:
GoMLX cannot currently trace logical batch data from native dataset production through transformation, placement, sharding, and training outcomes. Add first-class provenance without changing established values or control flow, so shuffled sampling, partial batching, concurrent delivery, and execution failures are diagnosable.

Give every ordinary and distributed batch valid immutable provenance. Stable identities survive cloning and inspection. Independent production occurrences and iterator runs have noncolliding identities without changing repeatability. Derive ancestry from ordered inputs, transformation details, output cardinality, and placement or sharding destinations, without inventing unrelated source identities.

Keep provenance paired with values through asynchronous and parallel operations, regardless of completion order, cancellation, partial output, or source failure. Report each source error once against the last delivered provenance. Mapping or upload failures create no successful child record but preserve the input relationship.

Validate consumed provenance before training. Validation failures leave variables unchanged. Report consumed identity, metrics, and success or failure without manufacturing output provenance. Preserve legacy TrainStep behavior, batching shapes and drop policy, device ordering, metrics, errors, step hooks, stopping behavior, and OnStep callback ordering.

Expose provenance-aware execution through `Trainer.TrainStepWithReport`. `Loop.On
